sources.finding: January 2026 NR OMR evaluated supplier submissions. White=no qualifying gigabit infrastructure and none likely within 3 years; Grey=one qualifying gigabit infrastructure available OR to be deployed; Black=two or more available OR to be deployed; Under Review=current/planned claims not fully verified or planned build with risks/evidence gaps. Counts: White 2,990,617; Under Review 2,179,083; Grey 9,157,988; Black 16,726,869; total 31,054,557.
Funding stages range from no funding, planned but not committed, to committed. Future_Technology design stages remain non-current until RFS/orderability criteria are met.
Premises-level transparency release provides January 2026 OMR determinations, current connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK interventions.
Independent current-availability context remains January 2026 fixed/FWA snapshot.

guards: White is a subsidy/gigabit classification, not NO_INTERNET
Grey and Black mix current and future infrastructure and cannot establish current availability alone
Under Review is explicitly non-final for current/planned claims
aggregate classification counts are QA context only, not parcel rows
not all active suppliers contributed, so NR OMR can differ from Public Review
where supplier did not contribute, Public Review may take precedence for IA eligibility
funding committed does not equal RFS/current availability
current product upgrade still requires exact current-r2 provenance
